review_kind: Implementation self-check; not an independent physical or safety qualification.
scope: Only semantic_controls.py, states.json, tests/test_semantic_controls.py, and this journal.
source_reference: Published task transistor_operations_v2; no remote edits or writes.

checks.method: Compared states.json source_conflicts object against parsed published source_conflicts.json for exact JSON equality.
Compared states.json source_netlist_contract against parsed published netlist_contracts.json for exact JSON equality.

guarantees_within_fixture_only: Strict identifier, dictionary shape, version/revision type and retention checks, including bool-vs-int rejection.
Sample ID/version/carrier identity remain immutable through fixture custody transitions; all ten explicit stack IDs required.
Actor deenergize intent is not safe-zero evidence; separate symbolic fixture marker required before mount/rewire/disconnect/retrieve.
Ordinary Fig4 and independent S31 full terminal maps remain distinct. Unsupported parallel S30 mapping is rejected.
Unknown or missing terminal identity is never inferred floating.
State-changing transitions invalidate earlier receipt metadata; receipt IDs cannot be reused; other fixture-instance markers are rejected.
Continuity markers bind exact sample/version, stack registry, driver/load pair, netlist ID/revision, terminal-map hash, mount/state revisions, and fixture namespace.
A metadata record consumes one continuity marker. No voltage/current result, synthetic curve, measurement, pass/fail electrical result, or computed electrical metric is created.
All physical service requests are rejected unconditionally, including after fixture conflict acknowledgement.
All C01-C10 source conflicts remain unresolved and qualification-gated; acknowledgements cannot resolve or bypass them.

interface.constructor: SceneControls(sample_id=..., specimen_version=positive_int, carrier_id=..., chip_id=..., pcb_id=..., cohort_id=..., architecture_id=..., stack_ids=[S1..S10], retained=True)
interface.fixture_observations: record_fixture_observation({receipt_id, kind: safe_zero|continuity, authority: synthetic_fixture_authority, scope: static_fixture_only, binding: receipt_binding(), outcome: fixture_safe_zero|fixture_continuity})
static_controls: rewire(netlist_id=..., driver_stack_id=..., load_stack_id=..., terminal_map=..., netlist_revision=next_integer, safe_zero_receipt_id=...)
interface.fixture_flow: safe_zero marker -> mount -> new safe_zero marker -> rewire -> new safe_zero marker -> continuity marker -> metadata record; disconnect and retrieve each require a current safe_zero marker.

limitations: A successful local guard proves metadata consistency only. No physical reachability, safety qualification, continuity, instrument response, or scientific replication is established.
Fixture observations are caller-owned symbolic data. Authority labels and instance namespaces are not authentication or production trust boundaries.
No geometry work, remote writes, measured electrical outputs, or synthetic electrical outputs occurred.
Passing this focused suite is not a complete package, geometry, or published task review.
